name: Declaration
definition: Details related to any statement or action, in any form prescribed or accepted by the Government Agency, giving information or particulars required by the Governmental Agency.

name: Document acceptance date/time
definition: Date and time of acceptance of a document in accordance with governmental legislation.

name: Document/message cancellation date/time
definition: Date and time when the document/message was cancelled.

name: Document effective date/time
definition: Date and time of effectiveness of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate, bond).

name: Document expiration date/time
definition: Date and time of expiration of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate, bond).

name: Message function code
definition: Code specifying the function of a document.

name: Functional identifier
definition: Identification of a specific information exchange.

name: Document identifier
definition: Identification of a specific document.

name: Document issuing date/time
definition: Date and time the document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.

name: Document issuing location identifier
definition: Identification of the location at which a document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.

name: Language code
definition: Code specifying the language used or requested.

name: Document/message rejection date/time
definition: Date and time when the document/message was rejected.

name: Document/message status code
definition: Code specifying the status of a document.

name: Document name code
definition: Code specifying the name of a document.
codeList: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list

name: Version identifier
definition: Identification of the version of a specific document/message number.

name: Reply type code
definition: Code specifying the type of reply required or transmitted.
codeList: UN/EDIFACT code list 4343 OR User code list

name: Requested validity period quantity
definition: Quantity specifying the requested validity expressed in days (i.e., it will be a number of days indicated in the data field and not a period expressed as "from ? until ?").

name: Total number of items
definition: Quantity specifying the total number of goods items within a document.

name: Total invoice amount
definition: Amount indicating the total of all invoice amounts in a single declaration.

name: Number of loading lists
definition: Quantity specifying the number of loading lists, manifests or similar documents.

name: Jurisdiction (authority) date/time
definition: Date and time of landing, bringing, or introduction at any place subject to a country's jurisdiction whether or not such landing, bringing, or introduction constitutes an import (e.g. the date of import used in US tariff laws).

name: Total number of packages
definition: Quantity specifying the total number of packages of the entire document (e.g. declaration/consignment).

name: Number of seals
definition: Quantity specifying the number of seals affixed.

name: Transport movement code
definition: Code specifying a particular transport movement.

name: Specific circumstances code
definition: Code specifying circumstances for declarations.

name: Number of split-consignments
definition: Quantity specifying the total number of split-consignments for a transit declaration.

name: Safety and security code
definition: Code specifying whether the declaration is combined with safety and security related declarations.

name: Transport charges method of payment code
definition: Code specifying the payment method for transport charges.

name: Freight rate quantity
definition: Quantity specifying the freight rate used such as 100 (if per 100 weight) 1000 if for 1000 kg.

name: Freight rate type code
definition: Code specifying the freight rate type: ocean, foreign inland, domestic inland, etc.

name: Freight rate amount
definition: Amount of actual freight rate charged for each mode of transportation used for an import or export freight movement.

name: GoodsConsignedLocation
definition: Details related to the location from where the goods were consigned.

name: Goods consigned location name
definition: Name of the location in a country from which the goods were initially dispatched to the importing country.

name: Goods consigned location/country identifier
definition: Identification of the location in country or country from which the goods were initially dispatched to the importing country.

name: Type of identification code
definition: Code specifying the type of identification used to identify a location.
codeList: User code list (see EU CDM code list for DE 16 15 046 000)

name: ResponsibleGovernmentAgency
definition: Details related to the responsible government agency.

name: Responsible government agency identifier
definition: Identification of the government agency, responsible for regulatory and statutory obligations.

name: Role code
definition: Code specifying the role of a party.

name: GovernmentOfficer
definition: Details related to the person appointed to some position of responsibility or authority in the government.

name: Government officer name
definition: Name of a person appointed to some position of responsibility or authority in the government.

name: Government officer identifier
definition: Identification of a person appointed to some position of responsibility or authority in the government.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Handling
definition: Details related to the handling and special handling of a consignment and/or delivery.

name: Handling instructions
definition: Directions for handling a consignment and/or delivery directions for a shipment.

name: Handling instructions code
definition: Code specifying the directions for handling a shipment and/or delivery for a shipment.

name: Origin
definition: Details related to the origin of the goods.

name: Country of origin code
definition: Code specifying the country in which the goods have been produced or manufactured, according to criteria laid down for the application of the Customs tariff or quantitative restrictions, or any measure related to trade.

name: Shipping marks
definition: Marks and or numbers on a transport unit or package.

name: PassiveTransportMeans
definition: Details related to the passive means of transport that is being transported by the active means of transport.

name: Passive transport means identifier
definition: Identification of the passive transport means.
codeList:
Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number

name: Type of identification of passive transport means code
definition: Code specifying type of identification of passive transport means.
codeList: E.g. IMO, MMSI, Call sign, External sign, ENI

name: Nationality of passive means of transport code
definition: Code specifying the nationality of passive transport means.

name: PreviousDocument
definition: Details related to the previous document.

name: Previous document identifier
definition: Identification of the previous document by number.

name: Previous document type code
definition: Code specifying the type of document used for declaration previously presented.
codeList: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list

name: Previously recorded declaration line number
definition: Number pertaining to the line in a previous customs filing.

name: WriteOff
definition: Details related to write-off documents.

name: Write-off quantity
definition: Quantity specifying the total number to be written off a document.

name: SupplementaryDeclarant
definition: Details related to the supplementary declarant, for risk analysis purposes.

name: Supplementary declarant identifier
definition: Identification of the supplementary declarant.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: TransportContractDocument
definition: Details related to the consignment which corresponds to one transport contract. (Known as consignment by the Transport group).

name: Transport document identifier
definition: Identification of the document evidencing a transport contract by reference number.

name: Transport document type code
definition: Code specifying the type of a document evidencing a transport contract.
codeList: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list

name: Split declaration indicator
definition: Indicator that the goods in the transport contract document are being cleared through multiple declarations.

name: Container legal status code
definition: Code specifying the container's legal status with respect to the International Convention on Containers.

name: Equipment supplier type code
definition: Code specifying a type of party that is the supplier of transport equipment.

name: Attached transport equipment code
definition: Code specifying a type of equipment attached to another piece of transport equipment, such as loading tackle, sheets, ropes, chains.

name: Packing material description
definition: Description of the type of material for packaging covered by UN/Recommendation 21.

name: Package dimension length
definition: Length of the package.

name: Package dimension width
definition: Width of the package.

name: Package dimension height
definition: Height of the package.

name: Package volume
definition: Volume of the package.

name: Package dimension diameter
definition: Diameter of the package.

name: Packer
definition: Details related to the party packing goods.

name: Packer name
definition: Name of the party packing goods.

name: Packer identifier
definition: Identification of the party packing goods.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: TransportEquipmentMeasure
definition: Details related to the goods weight, quantities, and amounts of a transport equipment.

name: Tare weight
definition: Weight (mass) of transport equipment including permanent equipment but excluding goods and loose accessories.

name: TransportedCommodity
definition: Details related to the properties of the transported goods.

name: UCR identifier
definition: Identification of the unique number assigned to goods being subject to cross border transactions.

name: Control result code
definition: Code specifying the results of a control.

name: DepartureTransportMeans
definition: Details related to the goods in the context of export.

name: Departure means of transport name
definition: Name to identify the means of transport used for the carriage of the goods at the time of departure.

name: Departure transport means identifier
definition: Identification of the means of transport at the time of departure.
codeList:
Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number

name: Type of identification of means of transport at departure code
definition: Code specifying the type of identifier of the means of transport at departure.
codeList: E.g. IMO, MMSI, Call sign, External sign, ENI

name: Type of means of transport at departure code
definition: Code specifying the type of means of transport used for the carriage of the goods at departure.

name: Nationality of means of transport at departure code
definition: Code specifying the nationality of the active means of transport used at the location of departure.

name: Mode of transport at departure code
definition: Code specifying the mode of transport used for the carriage of the goods at departure.

name: Destination country code
definition: Code specifying the country of destination.

name: Destination region identifier
definition: Identification of a country's subdivision of destination.

name: DispatchCountry
definition: Details related to the country from which goods were initially dispatched to the country in which the goods are located at the time of their release into the customs procedure.

name: Country of dispatch code
definition: Code specifying the country from which goods were initially dispatched to the country in which the goods are located at the time of their release into the customs procedure.

name: DraymanOrLighterman
definition: Details related to the party that moves goods within port limits on either land or water.

name: Drayman/lighterman name
definition: Name of the bonded party that moves goods within port limits on either land or water.

name: Drayman/lighterman identifier
definition: Identification of the bonded party that moves goods within port limits on either land or water.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: GoodsItem
definition: Details related to the goods item as declared to Government Agency.

name: Customs amount
definition: Amount declared for customs purposes of those goods in a consignment which are subject to the same customs procedure, and have the same tariff/statistical heading, country information and duty regime.

name: Buyer
definition: Details related to the party to which merchandise or services are sold.

name: Buyer name
definition: Name of the party to which merchandise or services are sold.

name: Buyer identifier
definition: Identification of a party to which merchandise or services are sold.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Seller
definition: Details related to the party selling merchandise to a buyer.

name: Seller name
definition: Name of the party selling merchandise or services to a buyer.

name: Seller identifier
definition: Identification of the party selling merchandise or services to a buyer.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Goods location type code
definition: Code specifying the type of goods location.
codeList:
UN/EDIFACT code list 3227
For use with the EU CDM:
- Code A  Designated location
- Code B  Authorised place
- Code C  Approved place
- Code D  Other

name: Authorization identifier
definition: Identification of the authorized location concerned as assigned by the relevant government agency.

name: ControlOffice
definition: Details related to the relevant governmental office where goods are available for further governmental control.

name: Control office type code
definition: Code specifying the type of control office (e.g. 5 - Customs).

name: Control office identifier
definition: Identification of the location of a relevant governmental office where goods are available for further governmental control.

name: EconomicOperator
definition: Details related to an economic operator in whose premises the goods can be controlled.

name: Economic operator identifier
definition: Identification of an economic operator in whose premises the goods can be controlled.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: GoodsReceiptLocation
definition: Details related to the location at which the goods are to be received by the consignee.

name: Goods receipt location name
definition: Name of the location at which the goods have been or are to be received by the consignee.

name: Goods receipt location identifier
definition: Identification of the location at which the goods have been or are to be received by the consignee.

name: HouseConsignment
definition: Details related to the transport between a consignor and a consignee as specified in the transport contract document.

name: Origin type code
definition: Code specifying the differentiation between different types of origin (e.g. preferential and non-preferential country of origin codes).

name: Passive transport means type code
definition: Code specifying the type of passive means of transport that is being transported by the active means of transport.

name: Previous document date/time
definition: Date and time of the previous document in accordance with national legislation.

name: SupportingDocument
definition: Details related to specific rules applicable together with reference data of the documents produced in support of the declaration.

name: Supporting document identifier
definition: Identification of the reference number of documents or certificates produced in support of the declaration.

name: Supporting document type code
definition: Code specifying the details required by any specific rules applicable together with reference data of the documents produced in support of the declaration.
codeList: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list

name: CustomsValuation
definition: Details related to valuation applying to the shipment.

name: Freight costs amount
definition: Amount indicating the total costs incurred by the shipper in moving goods, by whatever means, from one place to another under the terms of the contract of carriage. In addition to transport costs, this may include such elements as packing, documentation, loading, unloading, and insurance (i.e., to the extent that they relate to the freight cost).

name: GoodsShipment
definition: Details related to the movement and the handling of goods shipped together on one or more means of transport between original consignor and final consignee.

name: LoadingLocation
definition: Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignments) are loaded on to the active means of transport.

name: Loading location name
definition: Name of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are loaded onto the means of transport being used for their carriage.

name: Loading location identifier
definition: Identification of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are loaded onto the means of transport being used for their carriage.
codeList: UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User code list

name: NotifyParty
definition: Details related to the party to be notified.

name: Notify party name
definition: Name of party to be notified.

name: Notify party identifier
definition: Identification of a party to be notified.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Supplementary filing type code
definition: Code specifying the level of transport contract.
codeList: User code list (preferably new WCO codes)

name: UnloadingParty
definition: Details related to the party responsible for unloading goods.

name: Unloading party name
definition: Name of the party responsible for unloading the goods.

name: Unloading party identifier
definition: Identification of the party responsible for unloading of goods.

name: IntermediateCarrier
definition: Details related to the carrier who transports the goods from consignor to exporting carrier and/or from importing carrier to consignee or between other named points.

name: Intermediate carrier name
definition: Name of the carrier who transports the goods from consignor to exporting carrier and/or from importing carrier to consignee or between other named points.

name: Intermediate carrier identifier
definition: Identification of the carrier who transports the goods from consignor to exporting carrier and/or from importing carrier to consignee or between other named points, for a transit (in-bond) movement.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: IntermediateConsignee
definition: Details related to the party who takes possession of the goods from consignor to exporting carrier and/or from importing carrier to consignee.

name: Intermediate consignee identifier
definition: Identification of the intermediate consignees who may take possession of the goods from consignor to exporting carrier and/or from importing carrier to consignee, for a transit (in-bond) movement.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: TransitPrincipal
definition: Details related to the party accepting liability for goods held or moving under a customs authorization and - when applicable - a guarantee.

name: Transit principal identifier
definition: Identification of the party accepting liability for goods held or moving under a customs authorization and - when applicable - a guarantee.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: PropertyOwner
definition: Details related to the party owning a property.

name: Property owner name
definition: Name of the owner of the property.

name: Property owner identifier
definition: Identification of the owner of the property.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: StuffingEstablishment
definition: Details related to the location where the goods are loaded into the transport equipment.

name: Vanning party name
definition: Name of the party at whose physical location the goods are loaded into the transport equipment (stuffing establishment).

name: Vanning party identifier
definition: Identification of the party at whose physical location the goods are loaded into the transport equipment (stuffing establishment).
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: TranshipmentLocation
definition: Details related to the location where goods are to be transferred from one means of transport to another during the course of one transport.

name: Transhipment location name
definition: Name of the location where goods are to be transferred from one means of transport to another during the course of one transport operation.

name: Transhipment location identifier
definition: Identification of the location where goods are to be transferred from one means of transport to another during the course of one transport operation.

name: Transhipment location type code
definition: Code specifying the type of location of transhipment.

name: TranshipmentTransportMeans
definition: Details related to the transhipment transport means.

name: Transhipment means of transport name
definition: Name to identify means of transport at transhipment.

name: Transhipment transport means identifier
definition: Identification of the means of transport used at the time of transhipment.
codeList:
Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number

name: Type of identification of transhipment transport means code
definition: Code specifying the type of identification of transhipment transport means.
codeList: E.g. IMO, MMSI, Call sign, External sign, ENI

name: Nationality of transhipment means of transport code
definition: Code specifying the nationality of transhipment means of transport.

name: TransitControl
definition: Details related to the transit movement details for control purposes.

name: Control results at departure code
definition: Code specifying the results of the controls carried out by the authorized consignor prior to departure.

name: Transit control days quantity
definition: Quantity specifying the number of days a consignment is under transit control.

name: TransitDepartureLocation
definition: Details related to the location at which the goods depart under customs control of a transit procedure.

name: Transit departure location identifier
definition: Identification of the location at which the goods depart under customs control of the transit procedure.

name: TransitDestinationLocation
definition: Details related to the location at which the goods are destined under customs control of transit procedure.

name: Transit destination location name
definition: Name of the location at which the goods are destined under customs control of transit procedure.

name: Transit destination location identifier
definition: Identification of the location at which the goods are destined under customs control of transit procedure.

name: FacilityLocation
definition: Details related to a location of a facility.

name: Facility location name
definition: Name of the building or location that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry.

name: Facility location identifier
definition: Identification of a building or location that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry.
codeList: UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User code list

name: Facility type code
definition: Code specifying the facility type.

name: TransitOffice
definition: Details related to the customs offices of transit.

name: Transit office identifier
definition: Identification of the government office which is responsible for transit formalities enroute.

name: TransitTransportMeans
definition: Details related to the means of transport for transit.

name: Transport means for transit identifier
definition: Identification of the means of transport used for transit.
codeList:
Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number

name: Type of means of transport used for transit code
definition: Code specifying the type of means of transport used for transit.

name: Nationality of means of transport used for transit code
definition: Code specifying the nationality of means of transport used for transit.

name: Mode/type of means of intermediate transport code
definition: Code specifying the mode and type of means of transport which transports the goods from consignor to exporting carrier and from importing carrier to consignee.

name: Mode of transport used for transit code
definition: Code specifying the mode of transport used for transit.

name: Transport document issue date/time
definition: Date and time of issue of a transport contract document.

name: Transport document issue location name
definition: Name of the location where transport document is signed or otherwise authenticated.

name: Transport document issuing party identifier
definition: Identification of the party issuing the transport document.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Contract and carriage condition code
definition: Code specifying the conditions of contract and carriage.

name: Consolidator
definition: Details related to the party consolidating consignments in one large or master consignment.

name: Consolidator name
definition: Name of the party who has combined a number of smaller consignments into a single larger consignment.

name: Consolidator identifier
definition: Identification of the freight forwarder combining individual smaller consignments into a single larger consignment (in a consolidation process) that is sent to a counterpart who mirrors the consolidator's activity by dividing the consolidated consignment into its original components.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Deconsolidator
definition: Details related to the party responsible for dividing a consolidated consignment into its original single consignments and making them available for delivery.

name: Deconsolidator name
definition: Name of the receiving party of a consolidated shipment, who divides the latter into its original single consignments and undertakes to make them available to be delivered.

name: Deconsolidator identifier
definition: Identification of the receiving party of a consolidated shipment, who divides the latter into its original single consignments and undertakes to make them available to be delivered.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Unloading location name
definition: Name of the unloading location, seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which the cargo is to be unloaded from the means of transport having been used for their carriage.

name: Unloading location arrival date/time
definition: Date and time of arrival at port or airport with the intent to unload.

name: ContainerTerminalOperator
definition: Details related to the party operating a container terminal.

name: Container terminal operator identifier
definition: Identification of the party operating a container terminal or similar facility.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Control quantity
definition: Quantity specifying the control or quarantine purposes.

name: Declaration review location identifier
definition: Identification of the location where the declaration is reviewed by appropriate government agency. This may be different from place where declaration is lodged, paid, or acquitted.
codeList: UN/LOCODE + User codes  OR User code list

name: Control type code
definition: Code specifying the type of governmental examination.

name: Certifier
definition: Details related to the party which certifies something.

name: Certifier name
definition: Name of the party who has provided the certification.

name: Certifying party identifier
definition: Identification of a party which certifies something.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Control quantity
definition: Quantity specifying the control results of an inspection, carried out by cross border regulatory agencies.

name: CurrencyExchange
definition: Details related to rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.

name: Currency code
definition: Code specifying a monetary unit or currency.

name: Exchange rate
definition: Rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.

name: Declarant
definition: Details related to the party who makes a declaration to an official body or - where legally permitted - in whose name, or on whose behalf, a declaration to an official body is made.

name: Declarant name
definition: Name of the party who makes a declaration to an official body or - where legally permitted - in whose name, or on whose behalf, a declaration to an official body is made.

name: Declarant identifier
definition: Identification of a party who makes a declaration to an official body or - where legally permitted - in whose name, or on whose behalf, a declaration to an official body is made.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Declarant status code
definition: Code specifying the capacity in which the declarant is acting.

name: DeclarationGuarantee
definition: Details related to the undertaking given in cash, bond or as a written guarantee to ensure that an obligation will be fulfilled (e.g. under a transit procedure) related to a declaration.

name: Guarantee reference identifier
definition: Identification of the undertaking given as a written guarantee in cash, bond, or by other such means in order to ensure that an obligation will be fulfilled by reference number.

name: Security details code
definition: Code specifying details regarding undertaking given in cash, bond or as a written guarantee to ensure that an obligation will be fulfilled (e.g. under a transit procedure).
codeList: WCO code list/ObligationGuaranteeCode OR User code list

name: DeferredPayment
definition:
Details related to a deferred payment.
It may refer both to deferred payment of import and export duty and to tax credit.

name: Account identifier
definition: Identification of an account related to deferred payment.

name: DutyTaxFee
definition:
Details related to calculation of one instance of one duty, one tax, and/or one fee. 
Comment: Each instance of this class is to be used for a single occurrence of duty, tax or fee.

name: Duty/tax/fee reduced assessed amount
definition: Amount of deduction from a duty or tax.

name: Deducted quantity
definition: Quantity specifying the amount to be deducted from the tariff quantity to calculate the duty/tax/fee assessment basis for Customs.

name: Type of duty regime code
definition: Code specifying a type of duty regime.
codeList: UN/EDIFACT code list 9213 OR User code list

name: Duty/tax/fee assessment basis in quantity
definition: Quantity specifying the amount on which duty or tax or fee will be assessed.

name: Duty/tax/fee rate
definition: Rate of duty, tax, or fee applicable to commodities or of tax applicable to services.

name: Duty/tax/fee type code
definition: Code specifying a type of duty or tax applicable to commodities or a type of tax or fee applicable to services.
codeList: UN/EDIFACT code list 5153 OR User code list

name: Taxation date/time
definition: Date and time on which tax or fee is due or calculated.

name: Elected entry date/time
definition: Date and time used at the discretion of the filer for duty calculation of non-quota goods when there is no immediate transport entry date (related to immediate delivery).

name: Quota identifier
definition: Identification of an order specifying a quota.

name: DutyTaxFeeAssessmentBasis
definition: Details related to the amount on which a duty or tax or fee will be assessed.

name: Duty/tax/fee assessment basis amount
definition: Amount on which a duty, tax, or fee will be assessed.

name: Payment identifier
definition: Identification of the payment of a duty or tax by reference number.

name: Duty/tax/fee reduced assessed amount
definition: Amount of assessed duty, tax or fee due (includes all types of charges and duties) and amount of reduction (if applicable). Assessed per duty, tax or fee type by item and/or declaration.

name: Payment due date/time
definition: Date and time when an amount due should be made available to the creditor under the terms of payment.

name: ObligationGuarantee
definition: Details related to the undertaking given in cash, bond or as a written guarantee to ensure that an obligation will be fulfilled (e.g. under a transit procedure).

name: Security amount
definition: Amount of security in case that the type of security is in cash or in withdrawal from the security account.

name: Guarantee access code
definition: Code specifying access as associated with a given guarantee reference number.

name: GuaranteeOffice
definition: Details related to the government agency office related to the guarantee.

name: Guarantee office identifier
definition: Identification of the location of a guarantee office.

name: Surety
definition: Details related to the natural or legal person who accepts responsibility in due legal form for the financial consequences of non-fulfillment of another's obligations to the Customs (CCC).

name: Surety name
definition: Name of the party who agrees to be responsible for the debt or obligation of another.

name: Surety identifier
definition: Identification of the party who agrees to be responsible for the debt or obligation of another.
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: EntryOffice
definition: Details related to the office of entry.

name: Entry office identifier
definition: Identification of the regulatory office at which the goods enter the customs territory of destination.

name: ExitOffice
definition: Details related to the office of exit.

name: Exit office identifier
definition: Identification of the location of the regulatory office at which the goods leave or are intended to leave the customs territory of dispatch.

name: Exporter
definition: Details related to the person/party who makes or on whose behalf an export declaration is made.

name: Exporter name
definition: Name of the person who makes, or on whose behalf the export declaration is made, and who is the owner of the goods or has similar right of disposal over them at the time when the declaration is accepted.

name: Exporter identifier
definition: Identification of the party who makes, or on whose behalf the export declaration is made, and who is the owner of the goods or has similar rights of disposal over them at the time when the declaration is accepted.

name: ExportOffice
definition: Details related to the office of export where the export formalities are completed.

name: Export office identifier
definition: Identification of the office where the export formalities are completed.

name: FinalTransportMeansLoadingLocation
definition: Details related to the location where a consignment is placed aboard the final means of transport for the journey to a customs territory of a country or union of countries.

name: Final transport means loading location identifier
definition: Identification of a location where a consignment is placed aboard the final means of transport for the journey to a customs territory of a country or union of countries.
codeList: UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User code list

name: Departure date/time
definition: Date and time of the departure of the goods from original consignor.

name: Exit date/time
definition: Date and time when the goods depart from last port, airport, or border post of customs territory whence consigned (country of export).

name: Nature of transaction code
definition: Code specifying the nature of a transaction associated with a shipment.
codeList:
WCO code list/TransactionNatureTypeCode (n1) + User code (n1)
Remark:
* First digit indicates WCO code table value;
* Second digit can be used as additional user code to further define first digit

name: Free trade zone status code
definition: Code specifying that consignment into a free trade zone is a preliminary or final shipment.

name: Additional statement amount
definition: Amount expressed on the additional statement.

name: ContainerOperator
definition: Details related to the party to whom the possession of specified property (e.g. container) has been conveyed for a period of time in return for rental payments.

name: Container operator identifier
definition: Identification of the party owning, operating or controlling the transport equipment (e.g. container).
codeList: International code list (e.g. DUNS, EAN) OR User code list

name: Examination location type code
definition: Code specifying the type of examination place.

name: FreeTradeZone
definition: Details related to a free trade zone (or foreign free zone) where a particular consignment is to be or has been located.

name: Free trade zone name
definition: Name of Free Trade Zone (or Foreign Free Zone) were a particular consignment is to be or has been located.

name: Free trade zone identifier
definition: Identification of Free Trade Zone (or Foreign Free Zone) where a particular consignment is to be or has been located.
codeList: UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User code list

name: Loading location departure date/time
definition: Date and time / scheduled date and time of the goods departing from the place of loading.

name: Consignment loading date/time
definition: Date and time of initial loading onto a ship or airplane during one journey from export location to import location.

name: Charges amount
definition: Amount indicating the total cost of freight, insurance and all other costs and expenses from the foreign exit location to the entry location.

name: Qualifier for apportioning freight charges code
definition: Code specifying the method of the proportional allocation of freight charges for each consignment in a multi consignment declaration.

name: Valuation method code
definition: Code specifying the method on which the customs value is determined.

name: Party relationship indicator code
definition: Code specifying the effect of relationship existing between two parties such as financial relationship.

name: Terms of payment code
definition: Code specifying the terms of payment expressed in international terms (e.g., Cash on Delivery (COD), 30/60/90 due dates, discounts, commissions) under which transaction is completed.

name: Insurance amount
definition: Amount of premium paid/payable to the insurance company for insuring the goods.

name: ChargeDeduction
definition: Details related to the charges and deductions relevant to customs value (e.g. international freight, insurance, and post importation charges for construction, erection).
